_comment: Corrections for known upstream CFBD poll errors. phase = 'final' or a regular-season week number. rank null removes a bad entry. Applied after the raw join in build.py.

corrections.note: Ole Miss (11-2) finished #9 AP 2023; CFBD stored slot as Mississippi State (344).
Remove bogus #9 Mississippi State (5-7, unranked) from 2023 final AP.

_boundaries_comment: Mid-season coaching changes. through_week N = coach gets regular weeks 1..N only, no postseason. from_week M = weeks M..end + postseason. CFBD's per-season game counts are unreliable for recent/fired coaches, so we scope these by hand.

coach_boundaries.note: Fired Oct 12 2025 after the wk7 Northwestern game; later 2025 games were under interim Terry Smith.
Fired Oct 26 2025 after the wk9 Texas A&M loss; later 2025 games were under interim Frank Wilson.
